stopped_handling.mechanism: Connected twin mast/side reach guides and carriage. Low side guides outside front tyres; rear crossplate behind tyres and front plate ahead when low; actual model must prove all intermediate poses.
stopped_handling.release_sequence: After setdown, reverse withdraw with carriage extended; lift empty forks before full retraction.
stopped_handling.required_actual_proof: M14.8 continuous actual fork/carriage/tyre/HU/rack/traffic contacts and state timestamps, plus exclusive operator/vehicle/action space. A declared sequence is not an implemented action.
